Task Guide: Task: 
Task: Bulk Modulus of Aluminum
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of aluminum by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for aluminum. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

Thought: The EAM potential file for aluminum is "Al99.eam.alloy". I will now proceed to write the LAMMPS input script using this potential file to perform the finite deformation and stress analysis. This script will include the necessary settings and commands to compute the elastic stiffness tensor.

Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_3/lammps_input.in", "content": "
# LAMMPS Input Script for Elastic Constants Calculation
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/aluminum_bulk_modulus_trial_3/aluminum_structure.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Minimization settings
min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Deformation settings
variable delta equal 1e-06

# Loop over strain modes
variable i loop 6
label loop_start

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "change_box all x delta"
if "${i} == 2" then "change_box all y delta"
if "${i} == 3" then "change_box all z delta"
if "${i} == 4" then "change_box all yz delta"
if "${i} == 5" then "change_box all xz delta"
if "${i} == 6" then "change_box all xy delta"

# Run minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output stress
variable stress equal "-pxx -pyy -pzz -pyz -pxz -pxy"
print "${stress}"

# Next strain mode
next i
goto loop_start

# End of script
"}
